product_family: Viz.ai One, an AI-powered care coordination platform delivering over 50 FDA-cleared algorithms across therapeutic suites (Neuro/stroke, Cardio, Vascular, Pulmonary, Trauma, Radiology) for hospital and health-system providers, plus a separate Viz Life Sciences line built with pharma and medical device partners for clinical trial enrollment and patient access programs.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Viz.ai Announces Successful Completion of SOC 2 Type II + HIPAA Audits for Viz.ai One Platform... The assessment was conducted by an independent Big Four audit firm and evaluated Viz.ai's controls across the five trust service principles: security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy. Fourth consecutive year of SOC 2 Type II compliance (Feb 26, 2024 announcement).

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001
certifications.proof_quote: We have received internationally recognised security certifications to meet the ISO 27001 (information security management system) standard.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27701 (Privacy Information Management)
certifications.proof_quote: ISO27701 Security techniques, extension to ISO27001 for Privacy Information Management

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: Viz.ai has successfully achieved ISO/IEC 42001 certification, the international standard for Artificial Intelligence Management Systems (AIMS)... one of the first companies globally to achieve this accredited ISO/IEC 42001 certification.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 / ISO 27018 (Cloud security & data protection)
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27017 / 27018: Cloud security and data protection standards governing our cloud-hosted infrastructure.

certifications.name: ISO 27799 (Health informatics security)
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27799: Healthcare-specific security controls tailored for clinical environments and PHI.

certifications.name: ISO 22301 (Business Continuity)
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 22301: Business continuity and resilience to ensure uninterrupted clinical workflows.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Viz.ai operates a comprehensive HIPAA compliance program, including administrative, technical, and physical safeguards for the protection of PHI. Protected Health Information is governed by the HIPAA Business Associate Agreement between the Customer and Viz.ai.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: No independent GDPR certification exists as a formal third-party seal, and Viz.ai claims none. The vendor describes GDPR only as a self-managed compliance posture: 'In the United States Viz.ai is a regulated entity under the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act and has implemented several key security and privacy standards, controls, and measures to adhere to this act and to meet the requirements of others such as the GDPR... GDPR compliance via policies, processes, and audits.' The trust center additionally frames ISO 27701 as 'supporting GDPR and global privacy obligations.' This reflects a compliance posture, not a certification.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Viz.ai is a B2B/B2H healthcare software provider contracted directly with hospital systems; no cardholder-data-handling payment flow is described on the trust center, privacy policy, or press releases.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not listed on the trust center page or in any press release found; Viz.ai's public materials do not reference a federal government authorization.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not mentioned on the trust center page, privacy policy, or press releases.

privacy.ai_training_note: Viz.ai's core products are FDA-cleared clinical decision-support algorithms, not a generative or LLM chat product, and the company publicly states it uses separated training/validation/test datasets during algorithm development. However, no vendor-domain page explicitly documents whether a given hospital customer's imaging or EHR data is used to retrain production algorithms, or whether an opt-out exists. Protected Health Information use is instead governed by a separate HIPAA Business Associate Agreement that is not published publicly.
privacy.data_region: US (Viz.ai Inc., San Francisco, CA) with distinct regional entities and privacy policies for EU (Viz.ai Netherlands B.V., Heerenveen) and UK (Viz.ai Ltd., St. Albans); cross-border transfers use adequacy decisions or EU Model Clauses per the Trust Center Privacy Notice.

security.name: Independent security audits
security.value: Annual SOC 2 Type II audit (4 consecutive years as of Feb 2024) performed by an independent Big Four audit firm, covering security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy trust service principles.

security.name: AI governance program
security.value: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System) certification covering governance structure, risk/impact assessments, data governance, algorithm performance monitoring, and AI oversight integrated into engineering and quality processes across the full AI lifecycle.

security.name: PHI safeguards
security.value: Comprehensive HIPAA compliance program with administrative, technical, and physical safeguards; PHI use governed by a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement between the customer and Viz.ai.

security.name: ISMS oversight
security.value: Information security management system and associated certifications are owned by Viz.ai's management team, with day-to-day responsibility resting with a dedicated Chief Information Security Officer (CISO).

security.name: Trust portal / evidence sharing
security.value: A dedicated, gated trust center portal (powered by Drata) at trustcenter.viz.ai lets prospective customers request the SOC 2 Type II report, HIPAA documentation, and subprocessor list under NDA.

products.name: Viz.ai One (Provider platform)
products.data_scope: Protected Health Information (PHI): medical imaging (CT, EKG, echocardiograms), EHR data, real-time clinical communications
products.notes: Core hospital/health-system product; 50+ FDA-cleared algorithms across Neuro, Cardio, Vascular, Pulmonary, Trauma and Radiology suites. This is the platform explicitly named in the SOC 2 Type II + HIPAA audit.

products.name: Viz Life Sciences
products.data_scope: Aggregated and/or de-identified clinical data used to support patient recruitment, adherence, and clinical trial enrollment for pharmaceutical and medical device partners
products.notes: Separate go-to-market and data-use pattern from the direct-to-provider platform; no separate certification scope was found distinguishing this product line from Viz.ai One.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise/health-system contract, no public self-serve pricing
compare.data_residency: US primary (San Francisco entity) with separate EU (Netherlands) and UK entities and privacy policies; cross-border transfer safeguards (adequacy / EU Model Clauses) per Trust Center Privacy Notice

flags: Certification claims were verified via the public trust center marketing page, two independent Viz.ai press releases (SOC 2/HIPAA, ISO 42001), and the privacy policy, all on the vendor's own domain.

No vendor-domain statement explicitly addresses whether hospital or customer clinical data is used to retrain production AI algorithms, or whether an opt-out exists; PHI handling is deferred to a non-public HIPAA BAA.

GDPR is a compliance posture (internal policies, audits, EU Model Clauses, ISO 27701 'supporting GDPR'), not an independent third-party certification or seal; there is no formal GDPR certification to hold.

Three separate regional privacy policies (US, EU platform users, EU non-platform users) plus a distinct Trust Center Privacy Notice exist; a buyer should confirm which policy governs their specific relationship.
